symptoms: Leaf holes and feeding marks Dead heart symptom in young plants Stem tunneling Reduced plant growth
description: Stem borers are insect pests whose larvae feed on plant stems and leaves. They are common in cereal crops such as maize, rice and sorghum. Larvae bore into stems and cause internal damage that reduces plant growth and productivity.
management: cultural: Remove crop residues Crop rotation Use resistant varieties biological: Encourage parasitoid wasps and natural predators chemical: Apply recommended insecticides when infestation levels are high
